_meta.tuning: never used for tuning (generated for this build); still machine noise over well-known works, so it measures the cleaner and the retrieval ladder, not headline quality
_meta.scoring: lenient: expected_work, or same main-title key + expected_author name key (duplicate work records count); author_only: any work by expected_author. Status is not scored (no expected status).
